venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Chill Monday at CC ATL. Meal deal guests around 5-6pm, lull 6-7pm, picked up around 8pm until just after 10pm. Smooth last call. Bar team did deep cleaning during downtime. Met Bar Lead from Delbar Inman Park who'd never heard of Cocktail Codex — great moment of connection.

highlights.text: Steady Monday with good connection moments
Met Bar Lead from Delbar who'd never heard of Cocktail Codex

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Slower Monday night. Last night of NCAA March Madness Championship series, which should be good news going forward. Great night for engaging conversations with guests. Tay did deep cleaning of kitchen floors.

highlights.text: NCAA March Madness Championship keeping guests home
Great post-punk and college radio conversations at bar top

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.weather: Overcast and blustery, cool compared to last week
venues.notes_summary: Run of the mill Monday morning. Evening was surprisingly solid with a busy 4 o'clock hour and strong dinner period. Despite being understaffed in the kitchen (no expo, two cooks on the line), team pulled together beautifully — everyone helped run food and expo unprompted. No hiccups. Sun Club and Hot Eye closed (weather/Monday). Lots of out-of-town regulars returning.

highlights.text: Kitchen rockstars — 2 cooks, no expo, zero hiccups
Out-of-town regulars returning and loving Municipal Bar

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: D&C LA was closed Monday for Marquee floor repairs. Venue reopened Tuesday 4/7 in standing room configuration while repairs completed.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Slow night with Rockies home game and day after Easter. Pop at 6pm, another at 9:15pm. Opening server cut at 7:30pm. Held a happy hour event for GiveCampus with 40 guests in Garden & Suite 6A — taco bar was a hit and NCAA final game on TV. Event net sales $3,480.93 bringing total to $8,675.29. Mike Dees training on barback. Nik's last couple shifts.

highlights.text: Just missed target — $5,194 vs $5,199 target (-0.1%) excl. events
GiveCampus event added $3,481 — total w/ events $8,675
Rockies home game + post-Easter kept walk-ins low

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: Slow drip concentrated on the bar — 2-6 guests entering every 15 minutes until 10:30pm when flow stopped. Peak capacity ~80%. Haleigh did great handling disproportionate 3-4 tops using booths. Tenzin was a perfect teacher to Max on her final training shift. 40 oysters sold. Celebrated Zoe (Speed Rack winner) birthday. Fever Dream was a back catalog banger.

highlights.text: Slow Monday drip — peak 80% capacity, dried up by 10:30pm
Top Sellers: First Time Listener, Doves in the Wind, Material Control

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: The best 50 degrees has ever felt
venues.notes_summary: Solid Monday at 124! Started low on covers but by 8:30 rolling with a close to full floor. Josh was at Rammys finalists announcements so Jesse stepped up and led the floor — much appreciated. Oyster Monday special continues to do well, kitchen was more prepared with pre-shucked oysters. Floor cleared by 10pm for a quick and seamless close.

highlights.text: Jesse stepped up to lead floor while Josh at Rammys
Oyster Monday special continues to drive food sales (14%)
